title: Stock market outlook: JPM bumps S&P 500 price target, eyes AI monetization
excerpt: JPMorgan lifted its S&P 500 target to 8,000, citing expectations for AI profits to accelerate faster than spending in the future.
content_html:
JPMorgan just bumped its S&P 500 price target as it sees AI capex finally delivering for companies

By Jennifer Sor

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Returns on AI capex have been a looming question for Wall Street investors, but JPMorgan says that elusive AI monetization is a big reason it's boosting its S&P 500 price target for the year.

The bank's strategists hiked their target for the benchmark index on Monday, as they eye an "increasingly visible" payoff from the huge sums of money being poured into the AI buildout.

In a note to clients, a team led by the bank's Dubravko Lakos-Bujas raised their year-end forecast for the benchmark index to 8,000, a slight increase from the bank's prior year-end target of 7,800 and about 3% higher than Monday's levels.

Strategists cited higher earnings as investors finally begin to see the ROI from the billions spent in AI capex — a key concern that has weighed on hyperscaler stocks all year.

It's been a rough few months for the tech trade, with investors intermittently punishing large AI spenders as concerns build over valuations and whether all that capex will be worth it. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, for instance, is down 2% from its peak in May. Meta, one of the biggest spenders of the Mag Seven group, is down 7% year-to-date.

But the outlook for many of these firms has already started to improve during the second quarter, JPMorgan said. Strategists pointed to expanding backlogs, improved cash flow visibility, and stronger growth in cloud businesses, which have allowed firms like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft to clear "a high investor expectation bar," they wrote in a note.

"This suggests that monetization may start ramping faster than spending, which should support stronger future revenue growth and further alleviate concerns about ROIC," the bank said.

AI capex is expected to keep rising. The bank said consensus estimates now forecast total capex to reach around $900 billion by the end of the year, up about 85% from last year. The figure could rise to $1.2 trillion by the end of 2027, JPMorgan estimated.

Corporate earnings growth, meanwhile, shows no sign of slowing down. Of the S&P 500 firms that have already reported their results for the second quarter, 86% have beaten on earnings, and 76% have beaten on revenue estimates, according to the latest update from FactSet.

The index is also on track for the highest blended earnings growth rate in five years, the analytics firm said on Friday.

Despite the bullish outlook, strategists pointed to several risks that still hang over the market. Free cash flow at most of the hyperscalers will likely continue to be negative through 2027, JPM said. The US economy also remains K-shaped from a consumer perspective, the bank added, referring to the growing bifurcation between top earnings and lower- to middle-income Americans, who remain pressured by the cumulative impact of inflation.

该银行的策略师周一上调了基准指数的目标，因为他们看到投入人工智能建设的巨额资金将带来“越来越明显”的回报。

对于科技行业来说，这几个月是艰难的，投资者间歇性地惩罚大型人工智能支出者，因为人们对估值以及所有资本支出是否值得感到担忧。 例如，Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 较 5 月份的峰值下跌了 2%。 Meta 是 Mag 7 集团中支出最多的公司之一，今年迄今已下跌 7%。

但摩根大通表示，许多公司的前景在第二季度已经开始改善。 他们在一份报告中写道，策略师们指出，积压订单的扩大、现金流可视性的提高以及云业务的强劲增长，使得谷歌、亚马逊和微软等公司突破了“投资者的高期望”。

该银行表示：“这表明货币化可能会开始比支出更快地增长，这应该会支持未来更强劲的收入增长，并进一步缓解对投资回报率的担忧。”

人工智能资本支出预计将持续上升。 该银行表示，目前普遍预测资本支出总额将在今年年底达到 9000 亿美元左右，比去年增长约 85%。 摩根大通估计，到 2027 年底，这一数字可能升至 1.2 万亿美元。

与此同时，企业盈利增长没有放缓的迹象。 根据 FactSet 的最新更新，在已经公布第二季度业绩的标普 500 指数公司中，86% 的公司盈利超出预期，76% 的公司超出收入预期。

该分析公司周五表示，该指数也有望创下五年来最高的综合盈利增长率。

尽管前景看涨，但策略师指出，市场仍面临一些风险。 摩根大通表示，到 2027 年，大多数超大规模企业的自由现金流可能会继续为负值。 该银行补充说，从消费者的角度来看，美国经济也仍然是K型经济，指的是美国最高收入者和中低收入者之间的分歧日益扩大，而后者仍然受到通货膨胀累积影响的压力。
